title: 마일리지 만료 D-0
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop ballad featuring a male baritone vocal. The arrangement centers on a clean, fingerpicked acoustic guitar playing a steady eighth-note pattern. A warm, melodic bass guitar enters to support the low end with legato phrasing. Subtle, atmospheric synth pads provide a soft harmonic wash in the background. The vocal delivery is intimate and breathy, utilizing a narrow dynamic range. The tempo is 72 BPM in 4/4 time, likely in the key of E major.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[fingerpicked acoustic guitar]

[Verse 1]
[male baritone vocals, breathy delivery]
형광등이 치직거려
자판기 커피 한 모금
쓰디쓴 새벽 네 시 반 [bass guitar enters]
터미널엔 나 혼자뿐이야
청소 아저씨 빗자루 소리만
긴 복도를 쓸고 있었어
유리문 너머 하늘은 아직 남색도 아닌
어둠이야
